notes.title: Space Defender - Persistent Universe
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Deterministic Procedural Generation:[/b] Explore a more consistent and immersive universe with predictable planet and station generation.
[*] [b]Persistent Galaxies:[/b] Planets and stations now retain their location, inventory, and credits between sessions for a seamless experience.
[*] [b]Game Map:[/b] Press M to open the new galaxy map and navigate with ease!
[*] [b]Enhanced Ship Combat:[/b] Aim and shoot freely in any direction (within limits), independent of ship rotation, for smoother and more dynamic battles.
[*] [b]New Soundtrack:[/b] Enjoy 30 new music tracks! Check out the creators at alkakrab.itch.io.
[*] [b]New Sound Effects:[/b] Fresh audio effects added (work in progress, more to come!).
[*] [b]Low Health Warning:[/b] A red vignette screen effect now visually alerts you when your health is low.
[*] [b]Dynamic Difficulty Scaling:[/b] New mechanism adjusts challenge based on your progress for a more balanced experience.
[*] [b]Loading Screen:[/b] Added a loading screen for smoother transitions.
[/list]
[h2]Improvements[/h2]

[list]
[*] [b]Early Game Economy:[/b] Increased the amount of credits that the early stations own.
[*] [b]Pickable Objects:[/b] Improved collision detection makes picking up objects easier and more intuitive. Pickable objects also float for longer before disappearing!
[*] [b]Large Ship Handling:[/b] Boosted rotation speed for large player ships, enhancing maneuverability.
[/list]
[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]

Addressed various bugs to improve overall stability and gameplay experience.

[h2]Notes[/h2]
Stay tuned for additional content updates!
I’d love to hear your feedback on the new features and improvements :)

notes.title: Massive update for Space Defender!
notes.content:
[h2]Infinite Space[/h2]
Thanks to procedural generation, the game universe (space, stations, and planets) is dynamically generated in chunks around the player, making the universe virtually infinite — no more map boundaries!
[i]> Performance is improved as only the area around the player needs to be loaded.[/i]

[h2]Improved Enemy AI[/h2]
AI ships dynamically switch between different behaviors, such as:
[list]
[*] Navigate
[*] Attack
[*] Evade
[*] Keep Distance
[/list]

[h2]Enhanced Targeting and Combat[/h2]
Ships now adjust their shots with greater precision, making evasion maneuvers more challenging.
[i]> Additionally, firing patterns vary based on distance: the farther you are, the wider the enemy shot spread.[/i]

[h2]Boom![/h2]
Explosions of large ships and stations have been significantly reworked for greater realism.

[h2]Refined Controls[/h2]
Keyboard/mouse and gamepad controls have been reworked for smoother gameplay.
With keyboard/mouse, the ship automatically rotates toward the direction of movement.

[h2]Space Dust[/h2]
Added a dynamic fog effect in space that moves and changes color.

[h2]Inventory Management[/h2]
Jettison unwanted items into space and retrieve them if needed!

[h2]Optimized Code[/h2]
The game’s codebase has been significantly improved to facilitate maintenance and future development.

[h2]Price Adjustment[/h2]
To reflect the significant effort invested and the enhanced quality and scope of the game, a price increase will take effect soon.

[h2]And Also[/h2]
[list]
[*] Station shops remain accessible even after starting a mission.
[*] Missions are now located closer to the player, reducing travel time.
[*] The arrow automatically points to the nearest station.
[*] Improved health and energy bars: Redesigned for better visibility and ergonomics.
[*] Part of the menu and text has been redesigned.
[*] New tutorial mission: Added an easy introductory mission to guide new players.
[*] Progressive difficulty: The first five missions offer increasing difficulty.
[*] Improved item visibility: Floating pickable items now emit a colored trail for better detection.
[*] Missile behavior: Expired missiles now explode properly instead of disappearing.
[*] Rebalancing of difficulty and equipment stats.
[*] And much more...
[/list]

notes.title: Space Defender Blasts into Early Access – Join the Galactic Adventure!
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings, Space Defenders![/h2]

I'm thrilled to announce that [b]Space Defender[/b], my [b]indie 2D arcade space shooter[/b], is now available in Early Access on Steam! Crafted with love in France, this twin-stick shooter blends [b]fast-paced combat[/b], RPG ship upgrades, and a [b]relaxing open-world vibe[/b].

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1731170/extras/ExploreSpace.gif?t=1746489965[/img]

[h2]What’s in Early Access?[/h2]
In this initial release, you can:  
[list]
[*]Pilot your ship through dynamic top-down battles with intuitive twin-stick controls. Switch freely between your [b]keyboard & mouse[/b] or your [b]gamepad[/b].
[*]Wield [b]diverse weapons[/b] like laser cannons, turrets, and guided missiles.  
[*]Upgrade your ship with RPG-style progression, [b]balance energy consumption[/b], and buy better equipment.  
[*]Explore [b]three galaxies[/b] filled with stations and planets, with a chill, ambient atmosphere.
[*]Buy [b]more powerful ships[/b] with your hard-earned credits.
[*]Play in [b]English[/b] or [b]French[/b], with full localization.
[/list]
Space Defender is built to [b]run smoothly on low-end PCs and laptops[/b], so everyone can join the fight!

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1731170/extras/Fight.gif?t=1746489965[/img]

[h2]Why Early Access?[/h2]
As a small indie dev, [b]I want your feedback[/b] to shape Space Defender’s future. Early Access lets me [b]polish the game[/b] with you, adding [b]new content[/b], mission variety and features over the next 4–6 months. 

[h2]Join the Community![/h2]
Share feedback, report bugs, or suggest features in the Steam Discussions, or on our [url=https://discord.gg/rjDQaCTm]Discord Server[/url].

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1731170/Space_Defender/ style=button]Join our Discord[/url]

[h2]Special Launch Offer[/h2]
To celebrate, Space Defender is [b]20% off[/b] for the first 2 weeks of Early Access! Grab it now for just [b]$3.99[/b] and start exploring the stars.

[img]https://shared.fastly.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/1731170/extras/Travel.gif?t=1746489965[/img]
 
[h2]About me[/h2]
“I’m a [b]solo dev[/b] from France, and Space Defender is my [b]passion side-project[/b]. I poured [b]countless hours[/b] into creating a space shooter that’s both thrilling and chill, with a nod to classic arcade games. This is also my [b]first game[/b], and I can’t wait to hear what you think!”

Ready to defend the cosmos?
